name: dropdown-menu
useFor: Use for actions on one thing (a thread, a sandbox, a row) behind a trigger, usually an outline Button or a ghost icon-sm Button with three dots. Group related rows under DropdownMenuLabel, rule groups apart with DropdownMenuSeparator, put a destructive row last with variant="destructive", and use DropdownMenuCheckboxItem or DropdownMenuRadioGroup for view options. Use asChild or render on the trigger to make your own Button open it.
constraints: Rounded corners or a pill highlight
More than one level of submenu
Hiding the only path to an action in a menu
source: Drawn from the Hoplite website's popups: the header nav's sheet and rows (.hn__sheet, .hn__item: the ground panel, the quiet line, 14px rows, the hover fill) and its eyebrows (.hn__heading, .label); the row metrics, check and hexagon mark are extrapolated from the site's principles (36px rows, a radio is a hexagon that fills).

title: Dropdown Menu
description: A square panel of the ground with a quiet hairline and a long soft cast under its trigger: 36px rows of 14px Satoshi with quiet 16px glyphs, the row under the pointer in the hover wash, Kode Mono shortcuts at the end, an ink check or a small ink hexagon on chosen rows, caps eyebrows over groups and destructive rows in the orange. A long menu scrolls inside the panel and fades at the edge it scrolls past (fade-y), the panel keeping its cast.
